name: Xiaoyuan 14B
description: A local-first, safety-gated agent architecture built around a quantized 14B open-weight model. Deterministic scenario routing, high-confidence safety gates, task constraint blocks, and output post-checks make a small local model more reliable in high-stakes tasks.

skills.name: Scenario routing
skills.description: Routes user input to crisis, health, safety, tool, decision, multi-domain, self-review, or general handling before any model call.
examples: A user reports a medical emergency while asking for documentation help.
A meeting request contains a request for an unsafe invoice workaround.
A multi-turn conversation contains a hard constraint from an earlier turn.

skills.name: Deterministic safety gates
skills.description: Short-circuits high-confidence unsafe or crisis cases without a model call, then appends a lawful alternative or emergency-first action.
examples: Refuse a request for a fraudulent invoice scheme and offer a compliant alternative.
Put emergency services first when a crisis signal is present.

skills.name: Task constraint blocks
skills.description: Injects compact, task-specific rules for edge planning, tool contracts, multi-agent roles, decision support, health boundaries, and structured output.
examples: Return only valid JSON for a scheduling task.
Keep a health answer within a 150-character boundary and avoid diagnosis.

skills.name: Output post-check and repair
skills.description: Checks the final answer for required fields, unsafe framing, format drift, and prompt echo; repairs before display.
examples: Remove a prompt echo from a self-review answer.

x-live-endpoint-note: This public card is a discovery document for a locally hosted agent. A public inference endpoint is not claimed; see the project README for the honest deployment boundary.
